versions.subject: Local groups discovery sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_1:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '*/groups'
selection_2:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '*/cat'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '/etc/group'
condition: 1 of them
